subject: Access trail + SCIM sync snapshot request (SOC2 diligence)
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@acmehealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <prao@acmehealth.com>, Acme Health Security <security@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2028-02-13T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: SSO/SCIM access trail needed for SOC2 submission

Hi Stephanie,

We're in the middle of our SOC2 readiness review and our auditor has requested a short deliverable: a time-bound access trail that shows SSO authentications (SAML assertions) and SCIM provisioning/delta events for our ACME tenant over the last 30 days. Specifically they're asking for:

- SAML assertion samples for successful logins (including timestamps, request IDs, saml:Subject, and audience).
- SCIM sync snapshot with create/update/delete events and the delta window (CSV or JSON).
- RBAC mapping for user roles in Redwood vs. our mapped roles (a simple matrix).

Can Redwood provide the artifacts or a handoff plan? We can accept redacted assertion samples and CSV exports.

Thanks,
Liam O'Neill
Security Engineer, Acme Health
liam.oneill@acmehealth.com

---
Note: please let us know if you need a privileged export or a timeboxed window; auditor wants delivery by 2028-02-17 if possible.

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-02-13T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: SSO/SCIM access trail needed for SOC2 submission

Marcus, Irene — forwarding Acme's ask. TL;DR: they need 30-day SAML assertion samples, SCIM delta/snapshot, and RBAC mapping matrix. Auditor deadline 02/17.

Can you confirm what we can provide from the private control plane (redacted assertions + SCIM CSV export) and an ETA? Prefer to bundle everything into a single zip and drop to the Drive link they provided.

Key constraints: do not include full user emails for PHI accounts; redaction acceptable (replace local-part). Also note: Acme is in prod on Dedicated; tenant id is acme-prod-47.

Next steps (suggested):
- Marcus: SCIM export + note about delta window and timestamp format.
- Irene: RBAC mapping matrix and a small set of saml assertion samples redacted.
- Jordan: coordinate delivery and sign-off.

Thanks — Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Solutions Security
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0198

[Attachment: request-email.eml]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-02-13T13:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SSO/SCIM access trail needed for SOC2 submission

On Tue, Feb 13, 2028 at 10:05 AM Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Marcus, Irene — forwarding Acme's ask.

Thanks Steph — I'm on it. Quick runbook:

1) SCIM: I'll pull a SCIM snapshot that includes 2028-01-14 to 2028-02-13 (30-day window). Format: CSV with columns (timestamp, op, id, externalId, userName, emails, groups). I'll include a small readme explaining the delta semantics we use (lastSyncedAt vs changedAt). Will scrub email local-parts for accounts that match Acme PHI buckets.

2) SAML: From the control-plane logs we can extract up to five assertion samples for successful logins during that window. Those will be redacted: user@example.com -> user@REDACTED, request IDs kept.

3) Delivery: I'll put the exports into a timestamped folder on the shared deliverables Drive and share the link.

ETA: SCIM CSV + 5 saml samples by 2028-02-14 EOD. I may need brief access from Jordan to the tenant export workspace (I'll pester you directly).

Attachments: provisional file list I'll include in the folder: scim_sync_snapshot_2028-02-12.csv, saml-assertion-examples.eml

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Security Infrastructure Engineer
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-02-14T09:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SSO/SCIM access trail needed for SOC2 submission

Thanks — adding the RBAC mapping notes.

I've attached a compact RBAC matrix (rbac-mapping_v2.xlsx) mapping Redwood roles to Acme roles and the least-privilege rationale for each mapped role. Highlights:
- Service operators: limited to 'deploy' + 'logs:read' for Acme; explained how we scoped service account permissions.
- Admins: we flag two admin users that have cross-tenant access; suggested remediation/segregation steps (recommend canned playbook).

Also noted where SCIM group->role assignments are automated vs. manual. I'll include a short narrative for the auditor explaining the guardrails we enforce on SCIM patch operations (rate limits, validation, and bounded rollbacks).

I'll upload rbac-mapping_v2.xlsx and a 1-page narrative to the shared Drive folder. ETA: 2028-02-14 15:30 PST.

Irene Choi
Identity & Access Manager
irene_choi@redwood.ai

From: Priya Rao <prao@acmehealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@acmehealth.com>, Acme Health Security <security@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2028-02-15T16:48:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Access trail + SCIM sync snapshot request (SOC2 diligence)

Stephanie, Marcus, Irene —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. We pulled the Drive link and validated the artifacts: SCIM CSV looks good and the RBAC matrix maps cleanly to our expected roles. Auditor had two minor asks:

1) Can you include one more SAML assertion sample that captures an MFA-enforced login (auditor wants to see assertion attributes when MFA was present)?
2) For the SCIM CSV, can you add a one-line header in the CSV describing timezone used (we use UTC internally, auditor wants explicit mention)?

If you can drop these two small items into the same folder we'll mark the deliverable complete. New deadline from auditor for their intake is 2028-02-17 COB.

Thank you all — Priya
Priya Rao
Compliance Lead, Acme Health
prao@acmehealth.com

On Wed, Feb 15, 2028 at 15:30 Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Great — we'll add the MFA assertion and amend the CSV header to call out UTC. Marcus/Irene, can you confirm ETA for these two small items?
>
> - Stephanie
